guide: claude (opencode director session 2026-11-21): the statements of its own held proof (DECISIONS 2026-11-21), propositions only

generation.revision_note: no revision pinned: only hint_pairs batches load a frozen revision (tools/prover_kernel.py:90-98), and `model` stays the bare id because prover.canary_refusal compares it exactly
generation.settings: max_tokens 16000, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, half precision, 2 x T4 (tools/prover_kernel.py at the commit that carries this manifest)
generation.prompt: the kernel's PROMPT, unchanged: the hole's file with `sorry`, then the proof-plan instruction
generation.expected: about 2 h of the week's free GPU hours by the 2026-11-16 rate (48 samples in 112 min); queue time unknown; $0

judging.lean: leanprover/lean4:v4.33.1, mathlib v4.33.1 (lake-manifest.json), the judge of tools/check.py
judging.order: Lean's baseline recipes on every hole first; then each sample of an open hole in sample order (a fenced `theorem sb_goal` block); a rejected proof goes through the free chain before it counts; the first accept closes the hole; with all holes closed the whole proof is judged
judging.attribution: closed_by is lean or kaggle-goedel-prover-v2-8b; a try the free chain rescued carries repaired=true and is reported as prover plus chain

credit: a solve here is guided, and its guide is a frontier model that had already proved the problem: never 'free models plus tools', and never read as the prover solving the problem alone. Rows committed; accepted TEXT held in the prover run's artifact, not in verified/ or the site
claim: none. One problem, one blueprint, 8 samples a hole: whether a small prover can fill holes of a known-good decomposition, not a rate and not tool lift
before_any_comparative_claim: REQUIRED: the same prover cold on the whole problem with the same sample budget, and more than one problem (the sister manifest pilot-guided-kaggle-held-2026-11-21a on numbertheory_exk2powkeqapb2mulbpa2_aeq1 is the first)
